goodTests.summary: Executable checks exercise workspace/local paths, lifecycle scripts, prepared Git dependencies, platform filtering, malformed/missing-integrity/old locks, publication projections and two unchanged upstream test suites (commander with TypeScript and http-server). oneVersion.summary: Successful sample execution binds the exact pinned SDK point(s): Node 24.21.0, npm 11.19.0. Wider version intervals are not inferred.

nonEolVersions.summary: The reviewed revision executes maintained Node 22/24/26 line points with npm 10.9.2/11.19.0/11.12.1.
